ERPNext Warehouse Floor

The whole manufacturing flow on one line, left to right: supplier trucks unload raw materials at the receiving dock, Stores and Work In Progress silos (one per item type), the workbenches running Job Cards, the Finished Goods store, then delivery trucks loading at the dispatch dock.
